acceptanceRule: A8 closes only when every recoverable row is PASS, PRODUCT_DIFFERENCE with a verified local-Mac equivalent, or EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY with reference-backed unrecoverable-service evidence. PARTIAL/FAIL always keep A8 open.

stateSemantics.PASS: Executable target behavior is present with source/test evidence for the mapped reference behavior.
stateSemantics.PARTIAL: Executable behavior exists but reference breadth/state depth or visual/interaction equivalence is not closed; keeps A8 open.
stateSemantics.FAIL: Recoverable reference behavior has no sufficient executable target implementation; keeps A8 open.
stateSemantics.PRODUCT_DIFFERENCE: Reference behavior is specifically cloud-Computer/Box/cursor-agent infrastructure replaced by the user-required installed-Mac model; requires an explicit local equivalent where user-visible semantics remain.
stateSemantics.EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY: Reference depends on an external service/catalog/policy not contained in the pinned repository; target adapter/provider seam exists, but deployment evidence is external.
